summary: Walk the partial operation index in the operation drift audit

replay.detail: No replay or projection rebuild is introduced; the audit returns the same expected rows from the same store state.

schema.detail: No table, index, trigger or version change; the existing partial claims_operation_index is selected explicitly.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or replicated digest change.

compatibility.detail: The audit's results and every API response are unchanged; only the query plan differs.

downtime.detail: No migration or startup work is added.

recovery.detail: Behavioral no-op beyond query cost; binary rollback needs no store changes.
